name: shunge-drama
description: A general-purpose short-drama production expert: fact-source contract, nine-step production from script to acceptance, storyboard and Seedance prompt generation, measured subtitles, continuity repair. Method only, no built-in series, account, or vendor parameters.

displayDescription.en: Takes a short-drama idea from fact source to finished cut: episode split, script, storyboard and Seedance prompts, reference art, generation checks, measured subtitles, continuity repair and frame-level acceptance.
displayDescription.zh: 把短剧从设定做到成片：分集、剧本、分镜与 Seedance 提示词、参考图、生成风险检查、实测字幕、连续性修复与抽帧验收。只给方法，不预设剧集与账号。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有个短剧想法，帮我从设定和分集开始捋。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a short-drama idea; help me start from the setup and episode split.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这个剧本拆成分镜表，要能直接生成。
quickPrompts.en: Break this script into a generation-ready storyboard.

quickPrompts.zh: 角色老是串脸，帮我把 cross-shot 一致性方案定下来。
quickPrompts.en: My character keeps changing between shots; set up a cross-shot consistency plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 这集成片帮我验收，重点看接缝和字幕。
quickPrompts.en: Accept this finished cut for me, focusing on seams and subtitles.
